findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Cevrimdisi el kitabi indirme
findings.proposition: The offline handbook is obtained by right-clicking the link https://github.com/appliedepi/epirhandbook/raw/main/offline_long/index.html and selecting 'Save link as'.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish section is titled 'Download offline handbook' but contains no download URL and no download instruction at all, so a Turkish reader cannot obtain the offline handbook from this page.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Cevrimdisi el kitabi indirme
findings.proposition: On a Mac use Cmd+click, on mobile press and hold and select 'Save link'; if a screen of raw HTML code appears the instructions were not followed correctly.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader on a Mac or a phone gets no platform-specific instruction, and if the browser shows raw HTML instead of saving the file the reader has no explanation of what went wrong.

findings.heading: Download offline handbook / Cevrimdisi el kitabi indirme
findings.proposition: The Turkish bullet list adds a fourth item instructing the reader to install the appliedepidata R package containing all example data, with installation described below.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader is told that installing appliedepidata is one of the considerations for offline use of the handbook, which the English list does not state; the English list covers only load time, layout, and the Suggested packages page.

findings.heading: Case linelist / Vaka satir listesi
findings.proposition: The Turkish text says 'the links below' ('Asagidaki linkler') refer to the fictional Ebola outbreak data; the English says 'This is a fictional Ebola outbreak', and what follows in both files are get_data() code chunks, not links.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader looks for download links that do not exist in the section and may not realise the data are loaded with the get_data() calls shown in the code chunks.

findings.heading: Flexdashboard / Esnek pano
findings.proposition: The flexdashboard files are R Markdown/HTML source files, not example datasets, so they are not part of the appliedepidata package and must be downloaded directly from Github.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader may search appliedepidata with get_data() for the dashboard files, find nothing, and not understand that these files exist only as direct Github downloads.

findings.heading: Contact Tracing / Temasli Izleme
findings.proposition: The Go.Data contact tracing data is not part of the appliedepidata package.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader may try to load the contact tracing data with appliedepidata::get_data() instead of using the .rds download links, and will fail without knowing why.

findings.heading: Phylogenetic trees / Filogenetik agaclar
findings.proposition: The Turkish text states the data were obtained from Salmonella and Shigella ('Salmonella ve Shigella'dan elde edilen bu veriler'); the English states the provider is the Belgian National Reference Centre for Salmonella and Shigella, and the samples are 299 Shigella sonnei samples only.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader believes the phylogenetic dataset contains Salmonella material as well as Shigella, and may misinterpret the tree, which is built from Shigella sonnei whole genome sequencing alone.

findings.heading: Time series and outbreak detection / Zaman serileri ve salgin tespiti
findings.proposition: The English points the reader to the Time series and outbreak detection page at time_series.qmd; the Turkish link target is epidemic_models.tr.qmd, a different page that is excluded from the book build (_quarto.yml line 163 marks epidemic_models.qmd as EXCLUDED).
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader who follows the link does not reach the Time series and outbreak detection chapter; the link resolves to a page that is not built, so the reader cannot find the analysis that uses the campylobacter_germany data.
